question: Which two regions are zoomed in Figure 3.9, and does orange or blue indicate higher poverty on its legend?
answer:
Figure 3.9 zooms in on the Midlands & Northern Mountains and the Central Highlands regions. [p107-figure-3.9]

Orange indicates higher poverty on its legend. [p107-figure-3.9]
